extraction.Name: Julia Grandsinger
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded March 5, 1918, by the First National Bank of Valentine
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Peters Trust Company for $1600 on September 16, 1918; mortgaged to the Federal Land Bank of Omaha for $1600, interest at 5½%, payable in 69 annual installments on August 1, 1923
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612715 issued; North half of Section 16, township 36, north of range 25; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 11, 1918; Julia and her husband mortgaged to the Federal Land Bank of Omaha
